description: Dancing with the SARs is a phrase that suggests dealing with or adapting to SARs (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndromes) while continuing life with courage and awareness. It can describe the challenges caused by respiratory diseases and the importance of health, safety, prevention, and resilience.
summary: Project details wireless charging of vehicle
details: Wireless charging of vehicles is a technology used to charge an electric vehicle without directly connecting a charging cable. It works on the principle of electromagnetic induction. A transmitter coil placed on or under the ground transfers electrical energy to a receiver coil installed underneath the vehicle.
